description:
DECIDED 2026-11-13 by the user: remove 'name :: type' from patterns everywhere (fixtures, guides, tests, lib, compiler, docs). Three ways of stating a function's types existed: @spec, '::' on a parameter, and guards. '::' is fz-only (Elixir rejects it as 'misplaced operator ::/2'), duplicates a guard when it picks a clause and the @spec when it declares a domain, and keeps 28 fixture files from being oracle-checked. Measured on develop aa85cc3d9: lib has 61 typed parameters (bitstring segment specs '<<x :: binary>>' are a different construct and stay); 60 have an @spec just above; 51 pick a clause among several (become guards), 1 is a declaration only (File.close, kept by its @spec), 9 are Kernel's is_* type predicates themselves, which need a primitive underneath once '::' is gone (open design question). Outside lib: fixtures 53 files, fixtures2 29, guides 2, tests 2. Order: .1 rewrite fixtures/guides/tests while '::' still parses; then lib; then the is_* primitive; then delete the parser support, FnClause::param_annotations and its readers, SourcePatternError::ParamAnnotation, docs; '::' in any pattern becomes a spanned error (absorbs fz-4i4).
fz-xxd.16 (PR #537) adds Kernel.is_pid/1 and is_reference/1 in the same '_ :: type' form, so the type predicates needing a primitive are 11 once it lands.
title: Patterns carry no type annotations: clause choice is guards, declarations are @spec
